action.objective: Commit Qxc6, the only verified and commit-ready move.
action.rationale: Qxc6 is verified at depth 2 (exact, -195) with complete immediate-mate safety and no tactical refutation. It wins the c6 pawn and pressures the d6 bishop and b8 rook along the c-file (with Qb7 ideas), while Black's captures after are non-forcing. It is the sole commit-ready move; no replan required. No continuation supplied since depth is limited.
